quests.title: The River Line
quests.blurb: Clear the fog along the Deschutes. Touch any 3 of the 5 river cells in one ride.
quests.letter:
FOGLINE · THE RIVER LINE
You followed the water through the fog. The river keeps no record of who passes. Neither do we.

chapters.title: First Light
chapters.brief: Clear 3 cells you have never touched, in one ride.
chapters.letter:
FOGLINE · LETTER 1
You rode into the fog and it gave way. Few do. The city keeps its own map, and now it has noticed you.
The edges are thinner than they look. Go past them.

chapters.title: The Frontier
chapters.brief: In one ride, reach a new cell at least 3 cells beyond everything you have cleared.
chapters.letter:
FOGLINE · LETTER 2
You went further than the map expected. Out there the fog remembers nothing — not your name, not your road. Keep it that way.
One more push. Go where it is darkest.

chapters.title: Into the Dark
chapters.brief: Clear 8 new cells in one ride.
chapters.letter:
FOGLINE · LETTER 3
You cleared the line. No one knows the way you came, and no one ever will. The dark map is yours.
Thank you for riding. — the Fog
